question:
**Select the correct option:**

Only a transformative change has the power to ________ the deep-rooted bureaucratic stagnation.
solution:
The correct answer is '**dislodge**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**dislodge**" means to remove or force out of a position or place. (हटाना)
 
• The sentence suggests that only a transformative change can remove or unsettle the deep-rooted bureaucratic stagnation effectively.
 
• The other options: "**pervasive**," "**persuasion**," and "**inculcate**" do not fit the context appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Only a transformative change has the power to dislodge__ the deep-rooted bureaucratic stagnation.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Pervasive (व्यापक)**: means spreading widely throughout an area or group.
 
• **Persuasion (प्रेरणा)**: means the act of convincing someone to believe or do something.
 
• **Inculcate (मन में बैठाना)**: means instilling an idea, attitude, or habit through repeated instruction.
